description: This file defines the permissions service for the focalboard application, including permission checks for users on boards, teams, channels, and related entities.

classes.name: APIInterface
classes.description: Interface defining permission check methods for users on various entities.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Struct implementing permission checks, holding references to store, API, and logger.

methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Service instance with dependencies.
